description:
Hushfeed v0.20.0

This release adds the documented YTDLnis handoff profile with audio, video and background options, an optional limit for Hushfeed-owned automatic advance, and stronger Feature Gate Lab recorder isolation. The bundle also carries the completed feed, download, settings, diagnostics, translation and region work described in the changelog.

Validation: 460 runtime tests passed locally. The bundle contains 68 patches and all three DEX payloads passed verification for TikTok 46.2.3.
